Synopsis:
A Greek-operated Patriot air defence battery stationed in Saudi Arabia intercepted a drone swarm near Yanbu — a major oil refining hub — marking the third combat engagement since the outbreak of the US-Israeli war on Iran. The incident highlights an escalating pattern of attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure and the deepening involvement of European military assets in defending it.
